title: Look Back
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Fujino, a confident student cartoonist, is shaken when the reclusive Kyomoto's art outshines hers, and the two become creative partners. A later act of violence forces Fujino to reckon with grief and why she keeps drawing (to verify).
life_message: A life given to creative work and friendship, carried on through grief.

content.note: A sudden fatal attack on an art school (to verify).

Kyomoto is killed when a man attacks her art university with a pickaxe, and Fujino blames herself (Wikipedia); Common Sense Media's film review (11+) calls it 'a gut punch of a tragedy' with an ominous sequence of a weapon swung at a main character; the massacre itself is not shown.
Grief, guilt and social withdrawal (AniList Hikikomori 84%) (to verify).

winners_losers: Fujino's dedication to art and friendship endures; the attacker's act brings only loss. Sympathy goes to creative work and human connection.
